$description: Patterson Companies design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (draft). Every token carries an $extensions.com.patterson.source naming the document and page it was extracted from. Nothing is invented; gaps are recorded in DESIGN.md section 10.

color.$description: Patterson palette. Print/brand values from BG25 p.24; digital WCAG-adjusted values from DS20 p.7-8.

brand.$description: Primary, secondary and tertiary brand palette. BG25 p.24. Identical in BG22 p.27 and PCOM.

navy.$description: Primary. Headlines, brand accents, dark grounds. Clear thought, intelligence, communication, trust.

sky.$description: Primary. Default button/CTA colour (BG25 p.57). Dental video ground (BG25 p.52).

gray.$description: Primary. 80% black. Body copy and divider graphics.

white.$description: Background for content-heavy applications. Corporate + AHI video ground.

blue.$description: Secondary. Use when additional depth is needed; must not dominate the primary palette.

grayLight.$description: Secondary. Typically used as an accent gray on web pages and email.

teal.$description: Tertiary. Also the shipped eyebrow colour (DPL .eyebrow).

purple.$description: Tertiary. NOTE: DS20 p.8 and DPL record #512E91 (one digit different). BG25 is authoritative.

tint.$description: BG25 p.24 prints unlabelled tint swatches. Sampling the vector fills on p.24 shows a uniform 75/50/25 ramp over white for every palette colour. Values below apply that ramp to the published base hexes (round-half-up); they render within +/-1 of the PDF swatches. The step percentages themselves are NOT published: see DESIGN.md section 10 item 1.

digital.$description: DS20 p.7-8: 'A digital color system has been identified to comply with WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.' These are DIFFERENT hexes from color.brand and are what Patterson web properties render. Accent colours must NEVER be used for body copy or legal disclaimers (DS20 p.8).

sky.$description: Digital sky blue. Shipped as the .button background in DPL.

link.$description: Link blue. Substituted for sky blue on white or light grey backgrounds for WCAG 2.0 contrast.

green.$description: Accent green. Same value on light and dark backgrounds.

teal.$description: Accent teal. Same value on light and dark backgrounds.

purpleOnDark.$description: Purple for use on navy/dark backgrounds.

status.$description: DS20 p.37 names four message-box states (Positive, Error, Neutral, Urgent) but publishes no hexes. Values below are the shipped DPL implementation. NOT published in BG25: see DESIGN.md section 10 item 5.

semantic.$description: shadcn/ui semantic contract, light mode. Mirrors theme.css :root. Every value is an alias to a documented Patterson colour.

$extensions.com.patterson.source: BG25 p.24 (80% black for body copy); DPL body

primary.$description: BG25 p.57: 'Default color: Sky blue (#00A8E1)'. See conflict #1 in DESIGN.md section 9 - DPL ships #269BCB for WCAG reasons.

$extensions.com.patterson.source: DS20 p.15: navy outline, navy copy
BG25 p.24 - tertiary palette designated for infographics

semanticDark.$description: On-navy variant. Patterson publishes no 'dark mode'; it publishes an on-dark accent set (DS20 p.8) and a solid navy full-frame ground (BG25 p.52). Composed only from those documented values.

$extensions.com.patterson.source: DS20 p.8 - sky blue for dark backgrounds

destructive.$description: TBD: no on-navy error colour is published. #D0021B is low contrast on navy.

brand.$description: BG25 p.25 names Proxima Nova as the brand font at all three tiers. Production stack verbatim from DPL body{}. Licensed via Adobe Fonts (Typekit): load kit uth1qfm, which serves 400/500/600/700/800 in normal and italic - the full brand range including Semibold 600 and Extrabold 800. Reference the kit only; ship no font binaries and no @font-face. See brand-identity/references/typography.md section 2.

$extensions.com.patterson.typekitSuperseded: rul6mjk (pattersoncompanies.com) - serves only 400/700 normal+italic; does NOT serve Semibold 600 or Extrabold 800. Do not use.

office.$description: OfficeSuite: Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint. Body = Arial Regular; headlines and subheads = Arial Bold. Arial Nova Light available as an extra weight where installed.

weight.$description: BG25 p.25/p.27 names the Proxima Nova weights by role. Numeric values are the standard Proxima Nova mapping.

light.$description: Body copy alternative, by legibility and contrast.

regular.$description: Tertiary font. Body copy, long-form supporting copy. Marquee body copy.

semibold.$description: Secondary font. Subheads, secondary subheads, button/CTA text, all-caps titles and footers.

bold.$description: CTA (BG25 p.27). Secondary subhead in the p.27 specimen. Shipped h2/h3 and eyebrow weight (DPL).

extrabold.$description: Primary font. Titles, headlines, subheads. Marquee headline.

size.$description: Shipped web type scale from DPL. Print/layout specification is relational (see typography.leading / typography.tracking), not absolute.

cta.$description: BG25 p.57: 'Proxima Nova Semibold, 15px (larger if needed)'.

body.$description: Within BG25 p.27's published 125-150% range, at the top of it.

leading.$description: BG25 p.27 leading rules, expressed as a multiple of type size.

headline.$description: 75% of size. Example: 24pt type = 18.5pt leading. Applies to headline, subhead, secondary subhead, CTA, titles and footer text.

tracking.$description: BG25 p.27. InDesign tracking units are 1/1000 em. Optical setting throughout.

default.$description: Tracking -10. Headline, subhead, secondary subhead, CTA, titles/footer. Expressed as em in CSS: -0.01em.

largeScale.$description: Tracking -25, acceptable at large scale. CSS: -0.025em.

bodyMax.$description: Body copy is 0 to -10. CTA buttons are 0 tracking (BG25 p.57).

case.$description: Sentence case is the 2025 default and reverses the 2022 guide. BG25 p.25: 'All caps are to be avoided in any digital channel since this is regarded as shouting.' BG25 p.59: titles, headlines, subheads, text and captions are all sentence case.

titlePrint.$description: Titles MAY be all caps in print (BG25 p.25). Titles/footer text are Extrabold or Semibold, all caps (BG25 p.27).

emailSignaturePromise.$description: The brand promise line in the email signature is Arial Bold, all caps (BG25 p.28).

spacing.$description: Patterson digital work sits on a 5px grid. Inferred from consistent DPL padding steps (5/10/15/20/25/30/50/60/80) plus BG25 p.57's explicit 30px button padding. NOT published as a named scale in any Patterson source: see DESIGN.md section 10 item 2.

radius.$description: BG25 p.57: 'Rounded corners: 5px radius'. Confirmed as the dominant DPL value.

buttonHeight.$description: BG25 p.57. CONFLICT: DPL ships min-height 45px. See DESIGN.md section 9 conflict #6.

buttonPaddingX.$description: Width = type width + 30px padding on both left and right.

iconSize.$description: Web: vector SVG at 80x80px, code scales per pattern. Email: PNG at 80x80px @2x.

imageSize.$description: Documented image dimensions, @1x. From DS20 pattern annotations, BG25 and IMG20.

insidePattersonBanner.$description: Responsive; crops to as small as 1920x250.

pageIntroBgMin.$description: Export at larger than 200KB for quality, but as small as possible for loading speed.

_tbd.$description: Explicitly NOT extractable from any Patterson source. Do not fill these in without a source. Full list with reasoning: DESIGN.md section 10.

_tbd.namedSpacingScale: [TBD: not published in BG25 or DS20. 5px grid inferred from DPL.]

_tbd.proximaHeavyWeight: [TBD: 'Proxima Heavy' appears only at BG25 p.60 and is not defined in the typography section (p.25).]
_tbd.typekitKitSanctioned: [TBD: confirmation from Patterson's Adobe Fonts account owner that kit uth1qfm is an active, correctly-licensed Patterson kit rather than a legacy one, and whether rul6mjk can be retired. NOT a weight-coverage gap: verified 2026-08-11 that uth1qfm serves 400/500/600/700/800 normal+italic (10 faces, last published 2019-03-05) while rul6mjk serves only 400/700 normal+italic (4 faces, last published 2024-08-01). Semibold 600 and Extrabold 800 are licensed and serving; the fix was a kit swap, not an Adobe negotiation. uth1qfm being older yet richer is why sign-off is still required - the weights serving proves the kit is live, not that it is sanctioned.]
